name: (+/-)-α-methyldopamine
summary: α-Methyldopamine (α-Me-DA), also known as 3,4-dihydroxyamphetamine (3,4-DHA or HHA) or as catecholamphetamine, is a research chemical of the catecholamine and amphetamine families. It is a monoamine releasing agent and a metabolite of MDMA and MDA. The bis-glutathionyl metabolite of α-methyldopamine is slightly neurotoxic when directly injected into the brain's ventricles.

pharmacology.text: It is a monoamine releasing agent and a metabolite of MDMA and MDA.

uses.text: α-Methyldopamine (α-Me-DA), also known as 3,4-dihydroxyamphetamine (3,4-DHA or HHA) or as catecholamphetamine, is a research chemical of the catecholamine and amphetamine families.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is mainly studied as a breakdown product of MDMA. Its own effects in people have not been described, though its oxidation products are thought to be toxic to nerve cells.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它主要作為MDMA的代謝產物被研究。它本身在人體的作用沒有相關描述，但一般認為它的氧化產物對神經細胞有毒性。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它主要作为MDMA的代谢产物被研究。它本身在人体的作用没有相关描述，但一般认为它的氧化产物对神经细胞有毒性。

fact.en: The body makes it from MDMA and MDA, and its catechol group can oxidise and join with glutathione. Those products are one of the leading explanations for how MDMA damages nerve endings.
fact.zh: 身體會由MDMA與MDA生成它，而它的兒茶酚基團可能氧化並與穀胱甘肽結合。這些產物是解釋MDMA如何傷害神經末梢的主要說法之一。
fact.zhHans: 身体会由MDMA与MDA生成它，而它的儿茶酚基团可能氧化并与谷胱甘肽结合。这些产物是解释MDMA如何伤害神经末梢的主要说法之一。
